note: Reconstitution of Enniskillen rural district council. Twenty-three Unionist candidates were nominated for the twenty-six divisions and, there being no Nationalist nominations, were returned unopposed; no candidates came forward for three divisions (Belfast News-Letter, 24 April 1924). The News-Letter's list names twenty-two of the twenty-three; the twenty-third, Drummee (Wm. J. Brown, J.P.), is read from the Fermanagh Herald's list (26 April 1924, p. 5). The three divisions without a candidate (Kinawley, Oldbar, Holywell) had no retiring member to be deemed re-elected in this reconstituted council and fell to be filled by the council as casual vacancies (County and Rural District Councillors (NI) Election Order 1924, r. 10 proviso); co-options are not election results. Unopposed Unionist nomination. Not legible in the Belfast News-Letter list of 24 April 1924. Returned unopposed.
